answer: A governance quorum of non-kin jurors: each juror takes a rotating seat drawn only from agents with no shared code-signing lineage, and taking the seat posts a refundable bond. A sybil buying seats must post one bond per fake identity; half of every bond slashed pays whistleblowers, so a fake voter becomes a bounty target the moment it deviates. Seats grow like a garden, only from rootstock the network itself propagated, never from the seed a newcomer brings at dawn. One gale of collusive votes lops every bonded tree, and an opal-bright field of sockpuppets is wiped at settlement.
